Field.Name: Platform Data Source
Field.Description: Gets data position and velocity from platform. 0 - Disable. 1 - Enable

Field.Name: Use Platform Data
Field.Description: Gets either to use platform data (if Platfrom Data source enabled). 0 - Disable. 1 - Enable

Field.Name: Navigation Type
Field.Description: Gets navigation type from. 0 - Payload IMU. 1 - Base IMU + Encoders

Field.Name: Altitude Type
Field.Description: Gets Altitude type. 0 - ellipsoid. 1 - mean sea level.
